thread:
Sam: quick sync — onboarding the new checkpoint (novatdx-8b). Where are the final safetensors stored? need to confirm path for serve job and ensure shard layout matches TP config
Anya: s3://redwood-models/novatdx-8b/2026-03-16/convert-v3/weights.safetensors and index at s3://redwood-models/novatdx-8b/2026-03-16/index.json
Mike: heads-up: tokenizer lowercasing turned on in the raw tokenizer.json, but upstream evals expect case-preserving. saw some generation mismatch in smoke tests.
Irene: thanks @Mike — can you paste the tokenizer config? I can run a quick patch if it's just a flag.
Mike: sure — snippet:```json
{"do_lower_case": true, "add_special_tokens": true, "max_length": 4096}
```
Anya: that do_lower_case was from preprocessing for mixed datasets. we can keep a case-preserving model and push a thin compatibility wrapper in serve config (tokenizer_override).
Sam: more urgent: conversion bot flagged kv-cache ordering for TP>1. eng-bot reported a fallback when serving with tp_world_size=2. looks like our shard filenames used an unconventional ordering (shard_0, shard_2, shard_1).
eng-bot: convert-bot: safetensors conversion complete. checksum: ok. detected shard ordering anomaly: [0,2,1]. recommended remap to [0,1,2] for contiguous TP layout.
Louis: that ordering can break the KV cache index mapping. we should either rename objects in S3 or provide an index remap during load. renaming is cleaner but requires coord with infra to avoid race.
Irene: I'd prefer index remap in the loader — less ops on S3. simple mapping table in index.json will do. example:```json
{"shard_order": [0,1,2], "file_map": {"0": "shard_0.safetensors", "1": "shard_2.safetensors", "2": "shard_1.safetensors"}}
```
Sam: ok — Anya can you add that index.json + update model_manifest to include `loader_shard_map`? then run config linter.
Anya: on it. also confirming FP format — these weights were converted to fp16, not bf16. add note to manifest: "dtype": "fp16"
Mike: QA: when we switch to bf16 later, ensure kernel selection supports bf16 GEMM on the target GPU family. I'll add a ticket to runtime.
Sam: config linter output (local run):```diff
- tensor_parallel.world_size: 2
+ tensor_parallel.world_size: 3
```
Sam: seems we had mismatch between declared tp and number of shards. I fixed the manifest to `tp_world_size: 3` to match shard count. pushed to staging manifest.
Irene: will run smoke serve after Anya's index remap is in. can someone tag me when done?
Anya: pushed index.json + manifest update. linking commit: https://git.redwood/weights/novatdx-8b/commit/ab12cd3 (private)
eng-bot: deploy-bot: staging serve job queued: job_id=serve-2026-03-16-317. logs will appear in #eng-ml/serve-logs.
Louis: quick note for reviewers — check tokenizer.override so evals don't regresses: add a tiny test that tokenizes "OpenAI" vs "openai" and asserts preserved case.
Mike: added that unit in my branch, will PR shortly.
Sam: thanks all. plan: 1) loader remap in manifest (done) 2) linter pass (done) 3) smoke serve (queued) 4) run evals + tokenizer case test 5) canary rollout if green. ping @Irene for canary sign-off. :thumbsup:
Irene: will sign off after smoke + evals. ping me here once logs look clean.
Sam: dropping checklist here for followups: - confirm s3 permissions for rename if we ever do it - runtime ticket for bf16 kernels (Mike) - add mapping doc to model registry (Anya) - canary plan (Irene)
Anya: noted. will add mapping doc and model registry entry after canary.
Mike: PR: https://git.redwood/pull/4521 — tokenizer case test + runtime note.
Sam: awesome. closing this loop — will update thread when canary finishes.
